segments.text: I got a turtle. He got a dragon. And now we're fighting in the final.
In this town, on your tenth birthday, the Animal Saint gives you a companion for life. Strong kids get wolves. Brave kids get eagles.
I got a tiny turtle. The whole town laughed. But the Saint leaned down and whispered: take care of him. He's older than this town.
So I did. I named him Pebble. We were poor. Some nights, there was only one piece of bread. But Pebble always ate first.
And at night, his shell was always warm.
Then came Jax's birthday. The sky turned red, and a dragon landed in front of him.
Everyone called him the next great hero. And Mia, the girl I had liked forever, started holding his hand.
So I trained. Every single morning before school. In the rain. In the snow. Pebble never got any faster. But nothing could ever knock him over.
Then came the Grand Tournament. Jax's dragon burned through every round. And somehow, Pebble and I kept winning too.
Now it's the final. The whole town is watching. Jax smiles. His dragon opens its mouth,
and for the first time, Pebble's shell starts to glow.
Who wins? Comment turtle, or dragon.
